name: Application Insights
short_description: The application performance monitoring feature of Azure Monitor. It tracks request rates, response times, exceptions and dependency calls of applications.

evidence.quote: For your applications, you need application insights as your monitor's application performance management service.
Application insights is where these signal layers come together.
Application insights can tell you that a call succeeded. It cannot tell you that the call should not have been made.
